body:
> Inside the stories the select component keep the items in memory. It means that the more we search the longer is the list (see below). We can use the clearOptions() to remove all options before each a new render.

Nice catch, internally selectize keeps in memory options added and re-do a search into them.

> Note that the autocomplete widget is always tied with the main search. For example if we want to only target an different index than the main one we can't. We will need to use another instance and sync them together. The use case I'm thinking of is the e-commerce demo with the suggestions.

Yes it's true, good point, as a solution we can also provide another option to do not use the "main index" and so the user has to specify at least one index in the options. What do you think?
